scope: K14 Android SoM offline core only: node admission/numbering and deterministic PNG rendering over an already-authorized screenshot. No model tool, HTTP route, object publication, capture, migration or real device was added.
delivered: domain/som.py: SomNode/SomMark/SomSelection; nodes 1-128, canonical unique UUIDs, four-integer positive bounds, explicit visible/password booleans; only visible non-password nodes are marked; bounds are clipped to the frame and fully out-of-frame nodes are skipped/counted; <=50 marks in observe order with 1-based stable numbers and explicit truncated; frame caps reuse 8192 edge / 16M pixels; mark_map is a bounded internal mapping.

adapters/som.py: Pillow renderer draws same-size red target boxes and black/yellow number badges; only numbers enter pixels, never node ids/text/paths; zero marks returns the original PNG byte-for-byte; bad PNG, dimension mismatch or encode failure is android_som_invalid; input/output over 16MiB is android_som_too_large; no file read, object publication, database or model call.

9 new tests: zero/one/many nodes, 50+1 truncation, password/invisible/out-of-frame skips, bounds clipping, invalid ids/bounds/flags/duplicates, frame/node caps, bounded mark_map, renderer dimensions/pixels/determinism, zero-marks original, bad PNG/mismatched size.
Added both modules to strict include and docs/TYPE_CHECKING; no migration or shared interface change.

strict.note: two new modules added to include (430 -> 432); filesAnalyzed == include count

validation.ruff: domain/som.py, adapters/som.py and test_v2_android_som.py pass ruff check and format

retained_first_failures.reason: The first render test expected a red outline pixel where the number badge is drawn (badge wins); assertion moved to the node's right edge. Bad PNG raised PIL.UnidentifiedImageError, now mapped to android_som_invalid. A strict unknown-type error from len() on an object before casting was fixed by casting first.
